raw_response:
I am getting older, and there are only two people in my house, so this year I will not spread myself too thin. I will keep the wheat-maize on 10 mu because that is steady income and grain in hand feels safe. The other 5 mu I keep in cotton, same as what many people around here still do. I did not study much, so I do not calculate too fine. I mostly follow what worked on my land before and watch what the neighbors do. If I cut fertilizer too much, I worry the crop will look weak, but I also cannot spend carelessly. Water from the well helps, but pumping costs money, so I will use it at the important stages, not too often. Cotton takes more hand work, so I only keep a smaller area for it because my family labor is limited.
